metrics.name: Activos totales
metrics.definition: Total consolidated assets under IFRS, end of period.
metrics.comparability_note: Direct comparison across currencies (BRL vs PEN) requires conversion at period-end FX or PPP normalization.

metrics.name: Retorno sobre patrimonio promedio (ROAE)
metrics.definition: Annualized net income / average shareholders' equity. Dimensionless ratio.
metrics.comparability_note: Comparable across banks if period aligned. Reflects profitability relative to capital, not absolute profit.

metrics.name: Índice de eficiencia
metrics.definition: Administrative expenses / financial margin (Brazilian convention, Banco Bradesco). Personnel + other admin costs over recurring income.
metrics.comparability_note: Definitions vary slightly by jurisdiction (Brazilian vs Peruvian banking convention). Comparable directionally, not to the basis point without definitional reconciliation.

metrics.name: Cartera de crédito ampliada
metrics.definition: Total loan portfolio including expanded scope (Bradesco convention).

metrics.name: Casos de uso de IA en producción (auto-reportado)
metrics.definition: Number of distinct AI use-cases reported as running in production by the organization. Self-reported; no standard external definition.
metrics.comparability_note: NOT_DIRECTLY_COMPARABLE across banks. Definitions vary (what counts as a 'use case'), and self-reporting is promotional. Compare with caution; prefer qualitative maturity classification.

metrics.name: Clientes plenamente digitales (millones)
metrics.definition: Active customers served through fully-digital channels.
metrics.comparability_note: Definitions of 'digital customer' differ; do not rank without definitional reconciliation.

metrics.name: Costo de riesgo
metrics.definition: Loan loss provisions / average loan portfolio. Annualized.
metrics.comparability_note: Comparable across jurisdictions if period aligned.
